title: Agent-Driven Verification of Memory Safety for liblzma Decoder Components with VST
abstract: arXiv:2608.29716v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We report on the verification of memory safety for decoder components of liblzma, the compression library underlying xz-utils: the LZMA2 state machine, the LZMA1 decoder it controls, the outer decoding path, and the shared sliding-window dictionary. Built with the Verified Software Toolchain (VST), machine-checked body theorems establish memory safety and partial functional correctness. Across 27 completed body proofs, the largest covers lzma decode, whose 338 source lines expand to 1,934 lines of C after preprocessing; its proof comprises 183,268 lines of proof script over 775,768 lines of mechanically extracted goal statements. The verification exposed undefined behavior in raw LZMA1 zero-input handling, where range-decoder macros add zero to a null pointer and subtract two null pointers. Unlike similar work that synthesizes verified code, we verify pre-existing, production-scale C. AI agents complete proof goals and propose refinement

translated_title: 基于VST的liblzma解码器组件内存安全性的智能体驱动验证
translated_abstract: 我们报告了对liblzma（xz-utils底层所依赖的压缩库）解码器组件的内存安全性验证工作，验证对象包括LZMA2状态机、其控制的LZMA1解码器、外层解码路径以及共享的滑动窗口字典。该验证基于经验证的软件工具链构建，机器检查的主体定理建立了内存安全性和部分功能正确性。在27个已完成的主体证明中，规模最大的是lzma_decode，其338行源代码经预处理后扩展为1,934行C代码；其证明包含183,268行证明脚本，覆盖775,768行机械提取的目标语句。该验证发现了原始LZMA1零输入处理中的未定义行为，其中范围解码器宏将零加到空指针上并对两个空指针进行相减运算。与合成已验证代码的类似工作不同，我们验证的是预先存在的、生产规模的C代码。AI智能体用于完成证明目标并提出改进建议。
tldr: 本研究利用VST工具链和AI智能体对预先存在的生产规模liblzma解码器C代码进行了内存安全形式化验证，完成了27个机器检查的主体证明，并发现了LZMA1零输入处理中真实的未定义行为。
en_tdlr: This work uses the Verified Software Toolchain (VST) together with AI agents to formally verify memory safety of pre-existing, production-scale C code in liblzma decoder components, completing 27 machine-checked body proofs and uncovering real undefined behavior in LZMA1 zero-input handling.
